in_hebrew.name: Derrik
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו From the Greek 'Derde', meaning 'follower of Dionysus'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derrik הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In ancient Greek religion, Dionysus was the god of the vine, the grape harvest, winemaking, wine, table wine, ritual madness, religious ecstasy, and theatre.

in_greek.name: Derrik
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει From the Greek 'Derde', meaning 'follower of Dionysus'
in_greek.long_meaning: Derrik είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In ancient Greek religion, Dionysus was the god of the vine, the grape harvest, winemaking, wine, table wine, ritual madness, religious ecstasy, and theatre.

in_latin.name: Derrikus
in_latin.long_meaning: Derrikus est nomen Latinum, quod derivatur a Germanicis nominibus, quae significabant 'fortis' et 'fidelis'. In traditione Christiana, nomen istud est raro invenitur, sed potest esse significativum fortitudo et fides Christianae. In contextu Christiano, Derrikus potest significare hominem, qui fortiter et fideliter servit Domino Deo.
